title: Vietnam-region chlorophyll and monsoon winds
query: Using monthly MODIS-Aqua chlorophyll and NOAA blended winds for May–September 2004–2012 in the Vietnam-region box 109–112 E, 10–16 N, examine whether summer chlorophyll anomalies covary with meridional wind and scalar wind speed. Show regional series and raw versus calendar-month-anomaly relationships, and test sensitivity to dropping one summer at a time. This reduced analysis concerns chlorophyll concentration and wind association, not primary productivity, wind stress, an upwelling transport index or a circulation budget. Use only the supplied public data and coordinate-defined masks; no private profiles, author simulations or additional measurements are required. Report methods, executed numerical evidence, a concise interpretation and an editable analysis.ipynb. The reference paper motivates the diagnostic, but its observational values are not target answers for this adapted input.
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
